name: Edea
source:
A mysterious alien who foresaw a future in which Earth gets destroyed and came to help prevent it from happening. She has a stoic demeanor, rarely ever expressing her emotions but carries somewhat of a motherly atmosphere. She tasks [url=https://vndb.org/c119565]Manako[/url] with the role of savior, forcing him to take various actions to help save the planet.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
